exam: 101年特種考試地方政府公務人員考試
subject: 觀光英語
classes: 觀光行政(選試觀光英語)

essays.text:
解釋名詞：請用英文解釋下列名詞。（每小題 5 分，共 20 分）
①Ecotourism
②travel venues
③cultural landscape
④tourism infrastructure

簡答題：請用英文回答下列各題。（每小題 6 分，共 30 分）
①There are safety procedures to be followed onboard a plane. Please list three generalonboard announcements in order to have a safe flight.
②Please name one of the most famous food in each of the following countries:USA, Britain, France, Germany, Japan, and Italy.
③Please name six things that you’d better know about the foreign country to visit beforetaking a tour of that place.
④Give three examples of negative effects of tourism.
⑤English is a language which has more non-native speakers than native speakers.In some non-native English speaking countries, English has become or is becomingindigenized. This means that those non-native varieties of English, as a result ofwidespread and frequent use, have acquired or are acquiring relatively consistent, fixedlocal norms of usage which are adhered to by most speakers. Please name two wellestablished non-native varieties of English and show one feature for each of the selectedvarieties.

翻譯：請將下列中文譯成英文。（20 分）每年的聖誕季，紐約市美不勝收。現在就來一趟紐約市聖誕美景奇觀的徒步之旅。就從三十四街與百老匯大道交叉口之梅西百貨所在的先驅廣場出發。沿著三十四街的櫥窗，你可以聽到或看到整個有關聖誕老公公的故事。然後向東走到第五大道，沿著第五大道往北走，可以欣賞更多櫥窗擺設與路上行人。穿過第五大道，你很容易就能在洛克斐勒中心消磨一天。到了夜晚，人行道與街道就和白天一樣熱鬧。耀眼的櫥窗展示充滿了過節的氣氛。
作文：請就以下題目撰寫一篇短文（200-250 字），評量項目包括內容、組織、文法、用字遣詞。（30 分）Please write a short (200-250 words) essay to introduce a country of your choice fortourists to visit.
